_note: Which draw ships per bed, chosen by MEASUREMENT (audio/qa/music_draws_measured.json from `measure.py draws`). Empty until the first music pass. One entry per bed that is NOT served by its plan's first draw, e.g. "base_loop_a": {"src": "pf_base92a_v2__1", "why": "v1 chug 4.8 -> v2 1.9"}. Optional keys: bpmOverride (measured tempo when the onset comb is ambiguous), start (bars to skip after the first onset). One redraw per NAMED, MEASURED defect; the better draw by measurement ships; never a blind re-roll. Build-side keys added 2026-09-25: semis (whole-mix rubberband transposition for a draw in the wrong centre), onsetAfter (seconds of near-silence to skip before looking for the first onset), bars (a shorter whole-bar loop when the draw does not hold the planned length). r2 (2026-09-25): tailFill {fromBar, beats} = fill the loop's last `beats` beats with the same beats of phrase bar `fromBar` (build_audio.tail_fill: a composed rest at the loop end dips at every loop point).

base_loop_a.why: r3 redraw fold-in 2026-09-25, by measurement. measure.py draws: pf_base92a_v2__1 (the --force redraw) has ONE named defect left, a quiet intro (-13.2 dB, 1 bar), vs v1's five (chug 3.99, C-pent 0.559, near-copy sections 2-3 r 0.906, quiet intro -10.5 dB, dropout at 89 s): v2 chug 1.52, C-pent 0.732, max section r 0.756, no dropout. Built three ways (scratch root, same bed() code): start 0 = bar_lift +5.6 dB on bar 0, head-tail -4.7 dB at 1000 ms (every loop restarts on the lifted intro bar), grid self-sim 0.757, sliding 0.840, chug 1.29; start 1 (SHIPS) = no lift needed (min bar -2.0 dB re the median), head-tail 1.1 / 0.3 / -1.1 dB at 50 / 250 / 1000 ms, grid self-sim 0.834, sliding 0.838, chug 1.35, C-pent 0.756, limited 0.25 %; start 2 = self-sim 0.859 / sliding 0.871 (worse). Start 1 skips exactly the one quiet intro bar and ends (bar 33 at 86.1 s) before the draw's closing decay (material end 90.5 s). v1 draw retired (was: start 1 + bar_lift, chug 3.77 shipped).

rescue_loop.why: measure.py draws 2026-09-25: pf_rescue100__1's first 2 bars (4.8 s) sit ~5 dB under the body (sparser intro); starting at bar 1 leaves one quiet bar for bar_lift and still ends (79.26 s) before the closing decay (~81 s).

inferno_loop.why: measure.py draws 2026-09-25: pf_inferno100__1 came back in C minor/dorian (chroma C .24, Bb .17, G .13, Eb .09; C-pent share 0.546) instead of the planned A-minor pentatonic, so E and A of the hook and every C-pentatonic ladder would clash with its Eb/Bb. A rubberband -3 st transposition puts it on A (A dorian: top G E A C B) -> key-fit share 0.47 -> 0.76, C-pent 0.74 (+2 st, D dorian, measured 0.68/0.70 and moves the centre off A). Interim until pf_inferno100_v2 is drawn. r3 redraw fold-in 2026-09-25: pf_inferno100_v2__1 was BUILT as a candidate (raw, and key-fitted -2 st, the best share within keyfit's +-2 st; every other rotation moves the centre off A) and compared with this v1 -3 st build on the shipped loop: C/A-minor-pentatonic share v1 -3 st 0.780 | v2 raw 0.634 | v2 -2 st 0.704; chug 1.55 | 0.97 | 0.95 (all << 3); grid self-sim max 0.650 | 0.689 | 0.681; sliding self-sim 0.652 | 0.765 | 0.697; limiter load 2.94 % | 0.0 % | 0.0 %; head-tail at 250 ms 4.4 | 8.2 | 8.6 dB (v2's material ends at 77.5 s, 0.7 s after the 32-bar loop: its closing decay sits at the seam). v1 -3 st measures better on key share, both self-similarities and the seam; v2's only wins are chug (not a defect in either) and 2.9 % limiter load. v1 -3 st KEEPS shipping; v2 rejected by measurement.

backdraft_spins_layer.why: measure.py draws 2026-09-25: pf_backdraft92__1 is near-silent (-40 dB) for its first 5.25 s (2 bars) and decays from 44.5 s, the entry is at 5.275 s (first sample within 12 dB of the draw's peak after 5.2 s; a lone crackle pop at 4.64 s must not be taken for it); it holds 15.0 bars of material, not the 16 planned; the layer ships as 12 whole bars (three 4-bar phrases, even, so the two-bar brass stabs stay on the base bed's grid; the runtime phase-aligns layers modulo their own loop). Redraw requested (pf_backdraft92_v2) for the planned 16. r3 redraw fold-in 2026-09-25: pf_backdraft92_v2__1 measured WORSE than v1 (measure.py draws: quiet intro -25.2 dB, chug 4.06 > 3, C-pent 0.547 out of key, dropout at 46 s, vs v1 chug 0.79, C-pent 0.715), so v1 keeps shipping as these 12 bars; v2 rejected by measurement (not built).

anticipation_layer.why: measure.py draws 2026-09-25: pf_antic92__1 opens with 0.6 s of a -35..-44 dB pre-roll before the roll enters at ~0.7 s (-17 dB); the 4-bar layer starts at that entry (measured 0.775 s: the first sample within 12 dB of the draw's peak) so the loop head is not a dip (it ends at 11.1 s, before the draw's closing decay at ~12.8 s). Tempo: the layer is a continuous roll + tremolo, so the onset comb has no beat to lock to (fine_tempo 93.75 from only the 8/16-beat lags of a 16 s draw, autocorr 81.1, envelope comb 89-90): no reliable measurement, so bpmOverride 92 = the plan's tempo, no stretch (a 1.9% stretch toward a spurious 93.75 would only add WSOLA smear).

rung_bed_big.why: measure.py 2026-09-25: the loop's last beat sat in the draw's composed rest (-17.9 dB under the median beat; head-tail +25.0 dB at 250 ms, 6.8 dB at 1000 ms), and a rung bed loops for the whole count-up, so the dip repeated every 19.2 s. The end of bar 4 (the literal same phrase position) carries the same 2-bar phrase-end breath in the draw (its last 400 ms at -10.9 dB re the median, like bar 6 at -10.7), so the final half-bar (beats 31-32) is filled from the end of bar 7 (beats 27-28: the half-bar that leads into a downbeat without a breath), through a 30 ms splice and a re-made head blend; grid unchanged. Result: last 400 ms -3.0 dB re the median, head-tail 10.7 / 4.5 dB at 250 / 1000 ms (beat phase, like rung_bed_huge's 11.7).

rung_bed_mega.why: measure.py 2026-09-25: the loop's last 0.4 s sat at -14 .. -21 dB (head-tail +20.6 dB at 250 ms): the draw's 2-bar phrase-end breath (bar 6 ends the same way, -13.7 dB; bar 4's end is a breath too, so a fill from bar 4 changed nothing: measured -15.8 -> -15.8). The final half-bar is filled from the end of bar 7 (beats 27-28, no breath) through a 30 ms splice and a re-made head blend; grid unchanged. Result: last 400 ms -1.6 dB re the median, head-tail 6.4 / 2.4 dB at 250 / 1000 ms.
